provenance.post_title: Meet the Authors of the Year of Unfettered Exploration
provenance.asset_description: Artist Justin Usher : On a bright, sunny day a Polynesian-inspired dinghy pulls up to an island with a waterfall on the left and mountains in the distance. Behind the waterfall, there's a subtle sillhouette of a woman. The ocean surrounding the island is a comforting aqua blue. Taiwalei, a human Pathfinder, faces the viewer, excitedly beckoning toward the island, smiling and eager for the adventure ahead
